   55	# Tests always run in parallel: every worker owns its database clone and its compiled
   56	# caches, so bailing early costs nothing while a serial run wastes the session.
   57	#
   58	# The worker count is pinned rather than auto-detected. Laravel keys each clone
   59	# database off the worker token, so an auto-detected count on a many-core host creates
   60	# one full schema per core: dozens of databases, a persistent connection per clone, and
   61	# schema DDL that blocks behind those idle connections. A bounded count keeps the clone
   62	# set small and lets the same clones be reused across runs instead of accumulating.

   67	# The timeout runs *inside* the container, not around the `docker compose exec` client.

   69	# A docker exec client does not forward a signal to the process it started, so timing the
   70	# client out or cancelling it leaves the test workers running: they keep their database
   71	# transactions and row locks, and every later run then fails on a one second lock wait

  179	# One lane for every run on the shared test database. The harness takes the same lock file
  180	# (strategy-pipeline.py, key "verify:shared-test-database"), so an agent's test and a harness
  181	# verification never run together: two suites on one database fail each other, and each retry then
  182	# chases an error the other caused.
  183	with_test_lane() {
  184	    # The harness passes this when the calling attempt already holds the lane for its whole verdict.
  185	    if [ "${OGAMEX_LANE_HELD:-}" = 1 ]; then
  186	        # The harness holds lane 1's lock for a whole verdict; the run itself goes to a database of
  187	        # its own, never the one the scheduler and queue worker write to.
  188	        local rc=0 had_override="${AI_DB_OVERRIDE:-}"
  189	        if [ -z "$had_override" ]; then
  190	            export AI_DB_OVERRIDE="ogamex-test-harness"
  191	            prepare_lane_database
  192	        fi
  193	        "$@" || rc=$?
  194	        [ -n "$had_override" ] || unset AI_DB_OVERRIDE
  195	        return $rc
  196	    fi
  197	    # Lane 1 is the harness's lock and the shared test database. Lanes 2..N are the same tests on a
  198	    # database of their own (ogamex-test-laneN, migrated once), so a proof run no longer waits behind
  199	    # whoever holds lane 1: the wait was most of a 40 s test step.
  200	    local claims="$MODULE_ROOT/plan/research/ogame/claims" lock lane key rc=0 told=0 held="" had_override="${AI_DB_OVERRIDE:-}"
  201	    mkdir -p "$claims"
  202	    while [ -z "$held" ]; do
  203	        # Lane 1 is the database the running scheduler and queue worker write to, so a suite there reads
  204	        # their rows as its own; the lanes start at 2 and the lane count is how many private databases run.
  205	        for lane in $(seq 2 $(( ${OGAMEX_LANES:-4} + 1 ))); do
  206	            key='verify:shared-test-database'
  207	            [ "$lane" = 1 ] || key="verify:test-lane-$lane"
  208	            lock="$claims/$(printf '%s' "$key" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16).lock"
  209	            # A run killed mid-test leaves its lock; the harness ages its own out after 30 minutes too.
  210	            if [ -e "$lock" ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$lock" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) )) -gt 1800 ]; then
  211	                rm -f "$lock"
  212	            fi
  213	            if (set -o noclobber; printf '%s\npid %s at %s UTC (ogamex)\n' "$key" "$$" "$(date -u '+%F %T')" > "$lock") 2>/dev/null; then
  214	                held="$lock"
  215	                break
  216	            fi
  217	        done
  218	        [ -n "$held" ] && break
  219	        [ "$told" = 1 ] || echo "waiting for a test lane (all ${OGAMEX_LANES:-4} held)" >&2
  220	        told=1
  221	        sleep 1
  222	    done
  223	    trap 'rm -f "$held"' INT TERM
  224	    if [ -z "${AI_DB_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then
  225	        export AI_DB_OVERRIDE="ogamex-test-lane$lane"
  226	        prepare_lane_database
  227	    fi
  228	    "$@" || rc=$?
  229	    rm -f "$held"
  230	    trap - INT TERM
  231	    [ "$had_override" != "" ] || unset AI_DB_OVERRIDE
  232	    return $rc
  233	}

  285	# The one line that says why a step failed: pest's first FAILED line and the message under it, the
  286	# situation's read-back, the invariant's first [NAME] row, the aspect's count against its floor. A step
  287	# that printed none of those is described by the last thing it said.

  300	# Test steps first, stopping at the first one that fails: a red test makes the live steps meaningless
  301	# and they cost minutes on a cohort. The live steps run, all of them, only when every test passed, so
  302	# one run still shows everything that is wrong on the cohort. `--json` keeps stdout for the verdict
  303	# alone (progress goes to stderr) and ends it with one JSON line; proofs/CODE.log is rewritten per run.
  304	prove_row() {
  305	    local code="$1" as_json=0 steps ordered step kind name suspect started rc out results hours age
  306	    local progress=1 tests_failed=0
  307	    [ "${2:-}" = "--json" ] && { as_json=1; progress=2; }
  308	    steps="$(python3 "$MODULE_ROOT/plan/tasks/task.py" proof "$code")"
  309	    if [ -z "$steps" ]; then
  310	        echo "PROOF: FAIL $code states no proof (task.py proof $code test:X situation:Y aspect:Z invariant:NAME)" >&"$progress"
  311	        [ "$as_json" = 0 ] || printf '{"code":"%s","pass":false,"steps":[]}\n' "$code"
  312	        return 1
  313	    fi
  314	    mkdir -p "$MODULE_ROOT/plan/research/ogame/proofs"
  315	    out="$(mktemp)"
  316	    results="$(mktemp)"
  317	    # An aspect is judged only on play since the change landed: a window that reaches back before it
  318	    # measures the old code and can pass for the wrong reason. The writer's marker dates the change;
  319	    # a change made by hand uses PROVE_HOURS.
  320	    local marker="$MODULE_ROOT/plan/research/ogame/implemented/$code.md"
  321	    hours="${PROVE_HOURS:-2}"
  322	    age=$(( hours * 3600 ))
  323	    if [ -f "$marker" ]; then
  324	        age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$marker") ))
  325	        hours=$(( age / 3600 ))
  326	        [ "$hours" -gt 24 ] && hours=24
  327	    fi
  328	    # PROVE_FAST=1 runs only the test steps: a verdict in seconds, for the writer's own attempts. The live
  329	    # steps (a situation on the cohort, an invariant, an aspect) judge a delivered row later.
  330	    ordered="$(for step in $steps; do case "$step" in test:*) echo "$step" ;; esac; done
  331	               [ "${PROVE_FAST:-0}" = 1 ] || for step in $steps; do case "$step" in test:*) ;; *) echo "$step" ;; esac; done)"
  332	    local sim_done=0
  333	    for step in $ordered; do
  334	        # A trailing ? marks a step suspect: it is reported but never fails the row.
  335	        suspect=0
  336	        case "$step" in *\?) suspect=1; step="${step%?}" ;; esac
  337	        kind="${step%%:*}"
  338	        name="${step#*:}"
  339	        [ "$kind" = test ] || [ "$tests_failed" = 0 ] || break
  340	        # PROVE_SIM_HOURS=N: before the first live step, play N simulated hours on a copy of the cohort and
  341	        # judge every live step on that copy over exactly those hours. No waiting for wall-clock play.
  342	        # Opt-in (HARNESS_SIM_HOURS=N or PROVE_SIM_HOURS=N): measured at x5 on 3 Oct 2026, so 12 h took hours of wall time and blocked the only writer; off until the simulator is fast.
  343	        sim_hours_wanted="${PROVE_SIM_HOURS-}"
  344	        [ -n "$sim_hours_wanted" ] || [ "${OGAMEX_RUNNER:-host}" != local-docker-dev ] || sim_hours_wanted="${HARNESS_SIM_HOURS:-0}"
  345	        if [ "$kind" != test ] && [ "$sim_done" = 0 ] && [ "${sim_hours_wanted:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  346	            sim_done=1
  347	            echo "--- simulating ${sim_hours_wanted}h on a copy of the cohort" >&"$progress"
  348	            if SIM_DB="${SIM_DB:-ogamex-sim-prove}" sim_run "$sim_hours_wanted" --max-wall="${PROVE_SIM_WALL:-900}" >&"$progress"; then
  349	                hours="$sim_hours_wanted"
  350	                age=$(( hours * 3600 ))
  351	                # Tells the harness this verdict already covers simulated hours, so a failing live step
  352	                # needs no wall-clock settle before the writer gets the row back.
  353	                date +%s > "$MODULE_ROOT/plan/research/ogame/proofs/$code.sim"
  354	            else
  355	                echo "SIM: failed, the live steps below judge the live cohort" >&"$progress"
  356	            fi
  357	        fi
  358	        echo "--- $step" >&"$progress"
  359	        started=$(date +%s)
  360	        rc=0
  361	        : > "$out"
  362	        case "$kind" in
  363	            test) with_test_lane run_core ./vendor/bin/pest --testsuite=Modules --filter="$name" 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || rc=1 ;;
  364	            situation)
  365	                # A situation has a Situation-kit story that plays it in about a second on the test database;
  366	                # the live run waits for real workers and took 183 s. The kit story is the proof, the live
  367	                # run is the fallback for a situation no story covers yet.
  368	                story="$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed -E 's/(^|-)([a-z])/\U\2/g')SituationTest"
  369	                if [ -f "$MODULE_ROOT/tests/Feature/Situations/$story.php" ]; then
  370	                    with_test_lane run_core ./vendor/bin/pest --testsuite=Modules --filter="$story" 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || rc=1
  371	                else
  372	                    in_universe "${PROVE_UNIVERSE:-grand}" php Modules/AI/scripts/cohort-scenario.php run "$name" --confirm --cleanup 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || rc=1
  373	                fi
  374	                ;;
  375	            invariant)
  376	                # verify-cohorts names a violated invariant as "[NAME]"; its absence is the pass, but
  377	                # only when the read itself ran (it ends with a QUALITY line).
  378	                in_universe "${PROVE_UNIVERSE:-grand}" php artisan tinker --execute="require '/var/www/Modules/AI/scripts/verify-cohorts.php';" 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || true
  379	                if grep -q "\[$name\]" "$out" || ! grep -q 'QUALITY:' "$out"; then
  380	                    rc=1
  381	                fi
  382	                ;;
  383	            aspect)
  384	                if [ "$hours" -lt 1 ]; then
  385	                    # Under an hour a pass is still evidence (the floor scales with the window and never
  386	                    # drops below one event); only a fail has to wait for the full hour to mean anything.
  387	                    early="$(awk -v s="$age" 'BEGIN { h = s / 3600; printf "%.2f", (h < 0.1 ? 0.1 : h) }')"
  388	                    if in_universe "${PROVE_UNIVERSE:-grand}" php Modules/AI/scripts/play-scorecard.php --aspect="$name" --hours="$early" > "$out" 2>&1; then
  389	                        echo "early pass: the aspect already passes on the ${early}h since this change" >> "$out"
  390	                        cat "$out" >&"$progress"
  391	                    else
  392	                        echo "too early: the cohort has played under an hour on this change (not yet passing on ${early}h)" | tee "$out" >&"$progress"
  393	                        rc=1
  394	                    fi
  395	                else
  396	                    in_universe "${PROVE_UNIVERSE:-grand}" php Modules/AI/scripts/play-scorecard.php --aspect="$name" --hours="$hours" --save="$code" 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || rc=1
  397	                fi
  398	                ;;
  399	            harness) python3 "$MODULE_ROOT/scripts/strategy-pipeline.py" --self-check 2>&1 | tee "$out" >&"$progress" || rc=1 ;;
  400	            *) echo "unknown proof step $step" > "$out"; rc=1 ;;
  401	        esac
  402	        [ "$rc" = 0 ] || [ "$kind" != test ] || tests_failed=1
  403	        took=$(( $(date +%s) - started ))
  404	        # A verification step has a minute. The babysitter reads this file and builds the missing fast path.
  405	        [ "$took" -le "${PROVE_STEP_BUDGET:-60}" ] || printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date -u '+%F %T')" "$code" "$step" "$took" >> "$MODULE_ROOT/plan/research/ogame/slow-steps.log"
